_note: SPOKEN-UZBEK-ONLY lexicon for the UzbekVoice.ai (shoira) voice text. Owner's rule from listening tests: the voice cannot read English/Latin terms and letter-by-letter respellings sound bad, so the VOICE text contains only ordinary Uzbek words (loanwords written in Uzbek orthography are ordinary). On-screen subtitles are unchanged. Used by tool/tts/uz_prep.py. Every entry is NEEDS_NATIVE_REVIEW; 'approval: yes' = NEEDS_OWNER_APPROVAL. Apostrophes: o‘ g‘ = U+2018, tutuq = U+2019. Reusable for other apps' videos.

tokens.note: Formula spoken as words: I0 = kirgan nur, I = chiqqan nur (as the same sentence says), so A = decimal logarithm of that ratio. No letter names.

qc:L09.spoken: Ketma-ket qiymatlarning bir tomonga og‘ishi, tizimli xato, ya’ni siljish.

tokens.note: Three Westgard rules (2-2s, 4-1s, 10x) all mean consecutive values on the same side of the mean; spoken as that summary. Individual rule names stay in the subtitle.
